messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rolling canary: SDK v1.9 -> prod (route: /v1/paging, 3% canary hosts). deploy_id=deploy-1945678901 :rocket:
incident-bot: Alert: 5xx spike on /v1/paging (latency p95 up, error rate ~12% over 5m). Source=prod-metrics. Suggested priority=P1 :warning:
sre_oncall_jess: Ack. I’m the oncall, looking now — paging errors spike right after canary start?
platform_eng_rahul: Confirming query traces show streaming handshake failures (client closes stream with PROTOCOL_ERROR). Looks like client/server header mismatch.
sdk_lead_amy: We did bump default frame header for streaming in 1.9 (saw this in internal canary but missed old clients). Pushing a compatibility flag was optional but maybe not respected by the server canary.
sre_oncall_jess: Immediate mitigation: can we stop the canary rollout and enable kill-switch for paging_v2? I want traffic back to stable behavior.
platform_eng_rahul: I can flip flag. Command I’ll run:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/paging_v2/state \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"state":"off","reason":"canary causing 5xx on prod","who":"rahul"}'
```
platform_eng_rahul: Running now...
deploy-bot: Kill-switch update: paging_v2 -> off (applied to 100% routes) — rollout halted for deploy-1945678901 :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Alert suppressed: 5xx rate dropping to baseline within 2m of flag change.
sre_oncall_jess: Confirming metrics: error rate back to ~0.8% and latency p95 normalized. Marking incident as mitigated for now.
support_zoe: Support note: initial triage — 6 customer tickets tied to paginated streaming errors, highest impact on customers A and B (enterprise). They’ve been notified we’re rolling back change/kill-switch applied.
pm_michael: On customer comms: advising SRE + Support to follow up with affected accounts, offer rollback timeline and ETA for fix. I’ll start a high-touch thread.
sdk_lead_amy: Next steps for devs: revert the header default in SDK v1.9 canary immediately, add compatibility guard. I’ll open PR and include a migration note.
sre_oncall_jess: SRE fix actions: 1) leave kill-switch off until we validate backwards-compatible handshake; 2) ask infra to abort any remaining canary hosts for deploy-1945678901; 3) run a targeted canary with compatibility flags once SDK patch is ready.
platform_eng_rahul: Aborting remaining canary instances now: `platformctl roll abort deploy-1945678901 --scope=canary` — done. Logs show abort completed.
sre_oncall_jess: Handoff: I’m documenting incident in pager duty and will hand to rahul for postmortem tomorrow 10:00PT. marking owner=@platform_eng_rahul for RCA.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1945678901. Severity=P1 -> mitigated. Please add timeline + root cause in the incident doc.
support_zoe: I’ve posted templates for affected customers and flagged for refunds/credits if needed. Ticket IDs: #2451 #2452 #2456.
sdk_lead_amy: PR opened: r/1234 revert streaming-header-default + add compatibility opt-in. Will request review from infra and QA.
sre_oncall_jess: Closing notes: quick kill-switch worked, rollback aborted remaining canaries, short customer impact window (~6 minutes peak). Handing to rahul+amy for RCA and release gating changes. :white_check_mark: 
platform_eng_rahul: Acknowledge handoff. I’ll own the RCA and the deployment checklists to prevent future header compatibility regressions.
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem must include timeline, root cause (SDK header default change + missing server compat check), mitigation steps (kill-switch + abort), longterm action items (release gating, automated client/agent compatibility tests). Due in 72h.
